fields.sha256: sha256 of submission.zip (kernel output verified byte-identical)
fields.submission_ref: Kaggle submission ref printed by the CLI
fields.authorization: Director decision with the AUTHORIZE line
fields.submitted_utc: Time the CLI returned the ref
fields.private_score: Private LB score (hidden until the end; null)
fields.runtime_fields: Any runtime/duration field from the Kaggle API/CLI (weak evidence; dec 034)
fields.completed_window_utc: Last PENDING poll and first final poll bracketing completion
fields.first_final_poll_utc: First poll showing a final status

note: completed_utc unknown at finer than the 30-min poll interval; T per dec 055 item 3 = first final poll - submitted_utc = 5h00m26s. Bundle carries the inherited FastAPI/docs_src hint (dec 057 caveat).
